BehaviorTree._description: Turns joint k k times clockwise, one stage per turn, then returns every joint to its start position.

GetJointPositions._description: Records where every joint starts: stage 1 turns from here, and the return comes back here.

Sleep._description: No joint state received yet: waits 50 ms before the next attempt.

OffsetJointPositions._description: Subtracts one full turn (2π) from the current positions: a clockwise turn.

FollowJointTrajectory._description: Turns joints 1 to 5 one full turn clockwise in 2.5 s, at half the acceleration limit of stepit: faster, motors 1 and 2 lose steps.
